name: me.proton.core.userrecovery.presentation.compose.DeviceRecoveryDialogActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this secure dialog when the app starts device recovery for an account. It presents the recovery step for that user and closes or returns when the step is finished.
disableEffect: If disabled, users who need this account-recovery step may be unable to restore access to the account.
